fair adjective

just, impartial

classical

Traupman 146, 152, 154

aequus, aequa, aequum

Declension on Wiktionary

fair, just, impartial

Other words

  • jūstus, jūsta, jūstum — just, lawful

    also used · classical · Traupman 195 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • incorruptus et integer — impartial

    also used · classical · Traupman 195

    “Uncorrupted and upright”: both words are classical of a judge or witness who cannot be bought (Lewis & Short s.vv.).
